specs_json.compute: 8-core high-performance CPU; EDU version adds NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (100 TOPS)

notes: The Unitree G1 is a compact ~1.3 m humanoid aimed at research and light manipulation, notable for its low $16k entry price. It offers 23-43 DOF depending on configuration, a quick-release 9,000 mAh battery giving ~2 h runtime, and knee torque up to 90 N·m via Unitree's low-inertia joint motors.

failure_modes.name: Knee joint motor overheating
failure_modes.symptoms: Thermal derating warnings, reduced walking speed, joint temperature alarms during sustained locomotion
failure_modes.mitigation: Limit continuous walk duty cycles, ensure ventilation paths clear, firmware thermal limits kept enabled

failure_modes.name: Ankle actuator backlash growth
failure_modes.symptoms: Standing sway, balance controller oscillation, foot slap on heel strike
failure_modes.mitigation: Periodic joint calibration via Unitree app, replace actuator when encoder residuals exceed spec

failure_modes.name: Battery quick-release connector wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent power loss on impact, brownouts during high-torque moves
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect latch and contacts each swap, avoid hot-swapping under load, replace connector housing at wear

failure_modes.name: Dexterous hand tendon/gear failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Finger position drift, grip force loss, stalled finger joints
failure_modes.mitigation: Cap grip force in software, avoid impacts on fingertips, keep spare finger modules

failure_modes.name: MID-360 lidar mount vibration fatigue
failure_modes.symptoms: Point cloud misregistration, SLAM drift after falls or long runtime
failure_modes.mitigation: Check mount torque after any fall, re-run extrinsic calibration monthly

failure_modes.name: Fall damage to torso shell and hip harness
failure_modes.symptoms: Post-fall joint comm errors (CAN timeouts), cracked covers, hip encoder faults
failure_modes.mitigation: Operate with gantry/spotter during RL policy testing, full harness inspection after falls
